subject: Is there any way to provide a "footer" to a shiny gadget?

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Is there any way to provide a "footer" to a shiny gadget?
parts: If I want to have something written at the bottom of a gadget, I'm not sure how to do that.  I was looking for a way to put perhaps a `miniContentPanel` but specify it a small height so that it'll be a footer.  I also tried using "position: fixed" or "position: absolute; bottom: 0" with CSS, but I can't seem to get something right.  Is there a good method of having a gadget footer?
